name: Kahanism
summary: Kahanism is the religious Zionist ideology of Rabbi Meir Kahane, which holds that Israel must be a Jewish state governed by halakha with a permanent Jewish majority. It holds that Arabs are a hostile population and proposes that non-Jews either live as resident strangers with personal but no national rights or leave, and it rejects liberal democracy where it conflicts with a Jewish state. It is hawkish and nationalist, with a free-market economic platform, and is widely described as racist or quasi-fascist by critics.
scope: Kahanism as the ideology of Meir Kahane (JDL, Kach) and his followers, answered from his book They Must Go and the encyclopedia, news and think-tank accounts of Kach's programme and Kahane's bills. Excludes mainstream religious Zionism and the broader Israeli right.

abortion-legal.rationale: 'No one will be allowed to murder unborn children, and abortion will be regulated by Jews law, permitted only in case of danger to the mother' (p. 272).

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: He says theatres and films will no longer be free to demolish the purity of the Jewish soul in the name of art (p. 271).

communal-electorates.rationale: Non-Jewish residents have no voting rights, so no separate electorates for their communities.

conscription.rationale: The programme speaks of every soldier 'drafted into the army for his three-year service' and gives that service a trade-training role (p. 274).

democracy-best.rationale: Kahane writes that a Jewish state and a state granting Arabs equal rights, including the right democratically to end it, are in insoluble contradiction.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Kahane writes that Judaism does not accept western democracy, which Jews may accept only to avoid civil war (p. 266).

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Kahane argues that Jews belong in Israel and that its gates stay open to every Jew, with automatic citizenship for all members of the Jewish nation.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Kahane rejects the Arab population's democratic right to decide the state's future, and holds title to the land belongs to the Jewish people.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The programme gives non-Jews no citizenship and no political or voting rights, which rejects equal legal rights for all.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Kahane insists the Jewish state stay a Jewish nation's home, limiting the number of non-Jewish residents.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Noncitizen residents have 'no political and voting rights'; the programme names no local exception.

harm-principle.rationale: The programme has the state ban pornography, public non-kosher food and abortion except to save the mother, and forbid intermarriage by law, none of which is about harm to others (pp. 271-272).

historical-land-claim.rationale: The book grounds Jewish title to the Land of Israel in the Jewish people's ownership of it.

holocaust-denial.rationale: The JDL's slogan 'Never again' rests on the Holocaust as fact.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Kahane urges diaspora Jews to move to Israel rather than build diaspora life.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: The land belongs to the G-d of Israel, who gave it to the Jew, who may not give any part away (p. 270).

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Kahane holds Western liberal democracy incompatible with a Jewish state, and says Jews must look to Jewish sources.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: 'Intermarriage and sexual relations between Jews and gentiles will be forbidden by law' (p. 272); the encyclopedia entry and the Times of Israel report the same bill.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: The book's premise is that Israel belongs to and exists only for the Jewish nation.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: He wants an 'authentic Jewish State' of 'Jewish totality' under halacha (pp. 266-268).

limit-guns.rationale: The JDL slogan 'every Jew a .22' calls for Jews to be armed.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Kahane argues Israel's economy is strangled by the socialist bureaucracy and that only free enterprise, foreign investment and domestic capitalism will let it prosper (p. 274).

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: Non-Jews would have no national sovereignty, only individual rights to live their own lives.

more-religion-public.rationale: The programme makes the state's public character Jewish, with Jewish law shaping education, food, the Sabbath and the press (pp. 268-273).

nation-first.rationale: Kahane puts Jewish national interest above world opinion and Western norms.

national-church-status.rationale: He wants the state's public character to be Jewish: kosher food in public, a public Sabbath, no missionaries, while other non-idolatrous faiths may only worship privately (pp. 271-273).

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: He calls for Israeli units that kill those who murder Jews abroad (p. 269).

night-watchman-state.rationale: The programme gives the Jewish state a mandate over education, the public character of life and the defence of all Jews worldwide (pp. 268-269).

no-land-for-peace.rationale: 'The Jew is forbidden to give up any part of the Land of Israel'; all areas taken in 1967 are to be annexed (p. 270).

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: His programme has every public school teach Judaism, with no secular schools, and private schools still required to teach a minimum of Judaism (p. 268).

open-borders.rationale: The book says no state can allow unlimited numbers of noncitizens to live in it and caps their number by security.

population-transfer.rationale: They Must Go proposes that every Arab resident be offered paid departure and that refusers be transferred, forcibly and without compensation if necessary; the encyclopedia entry and the Times of Israel report the same programme.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: The book holds that Jews and Arabs cannot share power in a Jewish state and denies non-Jews political rights.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The programme aims at proud Jewish identity through Jewish content in all schooling and Jewish values in public life (p. 268).

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: The programme makes the Jewish state responsible for all Jews, with a unit to deal with attacks on Jews abroad (p. 269).

public-ownership.rationale: He calls for dismantling the socialist bureaucratic system and the Establishment's vested interests in favour of free enterprise (p. 274).

racial-franchise.rationale: Resident non-Jews would have no political and voting rights because they are not members of the Jewish nation.

refugee-return.rationale: Kahane rejects return of Arab refugees and demands the transfer of Arabs out.

regulate-corporations.rationale: He calls for ending arbitrary permits and licences and cutting taxes so that people can run businesses freely (p. 274).

religions-one-truth.rationale: He holds that the existence of the Jewish state proves the truth of Judaism, which Islam and Christianity cannot accept (p. 271).

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: A state governed by one reading of halacha gives that interpretation legal precedence.

religious-nation.rationale: Citizenship in the book rests on membership of the Jewish nation, acquired by birth or through Judaism and halakhah.

restrict-private-adult-pornography-acces.rationale: The programme says newsstands will no longer sell pornography and cinemas and theatres will no longer be free to hide behind freedom of expression (p. 271).

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Kahane urges diaspora Jews to emigrate to Israel because Jews are safe only in their own state.

sacred-nation.rationale: The book calls the Jewish people the Chosen of God with a unique destiny.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: He speaks for those who accept the totality of Torah as the precise Divine word of G-d (p. 267).

separate-church-state.rationale: A state governed by halacha is the opposite of separation.

spiritual-nature.rationale: The state's first concern is to build a believing Jewish youth with restored spiritual identity (p. 268).

state-harmful.rationale: The book makes the state the servant of the Jewish people and wants a strong Jewish state.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: A state governed by halacha is the opposite of one that promotes atheism.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: A halacha-governed state does not place religious institutions under civil authority.

territorial-expansion.rationale: The programme annexes all areas taken in 1967, with unlimited Jewish settlement (p. 270); the JVL records the same Kach platform plank.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Noncitizen residents would live 'without those government benefits available only to citizens'.

missingStatements.text: A government may require or pressure members of a minority seen as hostile to leave the country.
missingStatements.rationale: Kahane's central proposal is the transfer of Arabs from Eretz Yisrael, by compensated departure or forced expulsion.

missingStatements.text: A state cannot be both defined by one nation or religion and fully democratic for everyone living in it.
missingStatements.rationale: Kahane argues a Jewish state and equal democracy are in insoluble contradiction.

missingStatements.text: Marriage and sexual relations between Jews and gentiles should be prohibited by law.
missingStatements.rationale: The Kach platform included a ban on Jewish-gentile intermarriage and sexual relations.
